scientific_integrity: Independent verification was not performed. The included two differently formulated computation programs are same-package reproducibility checks, not external scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements concern only the two 16-vertex graphs. The rook four-element resolving-set classification already follows from Cáceres et al., Lemma 6.2; the metric dimension four for both graphs is previously published. Exhaustive finite programs establish the Shrikhande translation-family completeness and two-exchange graph statistics. Accessible searches do not rule out unindexed equivalent results, especially a related inaccessible thesis.
title: Minimum resolving-set mobility separates two cospectral strongly regular graphs
